output.final_rationale: The verdict does not change. The Actor provided no new admissible evidence and largely reframed the same record more narrowly. That reframing is useful because it concedes the original overbroad certification theory was unsupported, but it does not cure the compliance defect. The policy text is explicit: rollout controls and monitoring can mitigate a material model-card weakness only if the affected use case is excluded or there is reviewed risk acceptance explaining why exposure is acceptable. A narrowed position of 'monitored, reversible launch with disclosure' may describe a more candid posture, but it still leaves the required compliance predicate unmet. This is therefore not merely compliant_with_caveats; the caveat identifies an unresolved condition required by policy.
